name: the unknown-state fallback is dropped, so a state GitHub adds later reads as finished and the warning goes silent on exactly the case it was not designed for
edits:
if state in UNRESOLVED or state not in {"SUCCESS", "FAILURE", "CANCELLED", "SKIPPED",
                                                "NEUTRAL", "TIMED_OUT", "STALE", "ERROR"}:
expect: ⭐ an UNKNOWN state counts as unresolved, never as done

name: FAILURE leaves the resolved list, so a red check is reported as still running and the warning fires forever
expect: FAILURE does not — it is resolved, just red

name: case folding is dropped, so a lowercase terminal state is misread as unresolved
expect: ...and in the direction the unknown-state fallback cannot mask: lowercase SUCCESS is still resolved

name: an unreadable HEAD stops being CANNOT RUN — with both shas None they compare EQUAL, so the check reports 'a watcher is armed' when it read nothing at all
expect: unreadable HEAD -> CANNOT RUN

name: unreadable checks downgrade from CANNOT RUN to QUIET — the fail-open where 'could not ask GitHub' is served as 'nothing to say'
edits: return CANNOT_RUN, ("CANNOT RUN: could not read the PR's checks from GitHub. TREAT THIS AS "
return QUIET, ("CANNOT RUN: could not read the PR's checks from GitHub. TREAT THIS AS "
expect: unreadable checks -> CANNOT RUN, not a quiet pass

name: ANY armed watcher silences the warning, so a watcher armed for an older commit covers a commit it cannot see — the exact bug this guard was written for
expect: ⭐ pending + armed for an OLDER sha -> WARN (the exact bug: a new push un-arms it)
...and the message SAYS the old watcher no longer covers this commit

name: the no-pending short-circuit is dropped, so a fully resolved run still warns and the guard becomes noise nobody reads
expect: resolved checks -> quiet even with nothing armed

name: the stale-watcher explanation is suppressed, so the reader is told to arm a watcher without being told why the one they armed stopped counting
expect: ...and the message SAYS the old watcher no longer covers this commit

name: the sentinel key check is dropped, so the FIRST key with a value is read as the watched sha and an unarmed sentinel reads as armed
expect: a sentinel with no sha line reads as unarmed

name: a missing PR is reported as CANNOT RUN again — the every-stop noise, restored
expect: gh reporting NO PR is not-a-subject, not a failure — (None, True)

name: ANY gh failure is read as 'no PR', so an unreachable GitHub goes silent
edits:
# ⚠ Keyed on gh's own sentence. If gh rewords it, this stops matching and the case falls back
    # to CANNOT RUN — noisy, not silent, which is the direction this guard must fail in.
    return None, True
expect: ...while ANY OTHER gh failure stays CANNOT RUN territory — (None, False)

name: the no-PR call site is dead, so the every-stop CANNOT RUN returns
expect: run_decide is QUIET when there is no PR — the branch is pushed, so there is no CI to be unwatched, and this is the every-stop CANNOT RUN the change exists to remove

name: the no-PR flag is forced TRUE at the call site, so the observer is silent on every branch forever
edits:
raw, no_pr = _pr_checks_raw()
    raw, no_pr = _pr_checks_raw()
    no_pr = True
expect: ...and NOT quiet on the same shaped input with no_pr FALSE — an unreadable PR is CANNOT RUN, so the verdict tracks the flag rather than being QUIET either way

name: a gh CRASH is reported as 'no PR', turning gh-missing and gh-timing-out into silence
expect: gh MISSING is CANNOT RUN territory, never 'no PR' — a crash must not read as silence

name: warn_reason collapses to ONE class, so a stale watcher and no watcher at all become the same event
expect: warn_reason tells the two classes apart — a watcher armed for ANOTHER commit is `stale`, nothing armed at all is `unwatched`

name: the log line drops its SESSION column, so entries stop being attributable to a session
expect: log_line carries all FOUR columns it is given, at two distinct inputs each

name: the log records EVERY stop, not only the warnings — destroying the one number it exists to produce
edits:
if code == WARN:
        # ⚠ RECORDED ONLY ON A REAL WARNING

if True:
        # ⚠ RECORDED ONLY ON A REAL WARNING
expect: ...and a QUIET turn appends NOTHING — a log that records the quiet turns cannot say how often this spoke, which is the only question it is for

name: a failed log write is SWALLOWED, so the false-alarm rate silently stops being recorded
edits:
message += (f"\n\n   ⚠ AND THE LOG COULD NOT BE WRITTEN ({e}) — the false-alarm "
                        f"rate is not being recorded.")
expect: an UNWRITABLE log still WARNS and says the false-alarm rate is not being recorded — it is part of the warning, not a swallowed detail

name: the Stop payload is ignored, so the session column is always `-` and cannot vary
expect: the SESSION column comes from the Stop payload the hook has always piped in
